title: quercus intricata
intro: Quercus intricata, commonly known as the Mexican white oak, is a deciduous tree species native to the mountain forests of Mexico and Central America. The health benefits of Quercus intricata include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may be beneficial in treating various conditions such as diabetes, cancer, and infectious diseases. The bioactive constituents of Quercus intricata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are found in its bark, leaves, and wood.
